mapper.sql: o.org00_org_code_id AS org_code_id, o.org00_org_cd AS org_cd, o.org00_kor_nm AS kor_nm, o.org00_parent_full_nm AS parent_full_nm, o.org00_level_cd AS level_cd, f_cdnm('OrgLevelCode', o.org00_level_cd, o.org00_company_id, o.org00_mod_date) AS level_nm, o.org00_mod_date AS mod_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM org00_org_info o WHERE org00_company_id = #{companyId} AND org00_kor_nm LIKE #{korName} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(x.org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info x WHERE x.org00_org_code_id = o.org00_org_code_id AND x.org00_mod_date <= #{baseDate} ) AND #{baseDate} BETWEEN org00_mod_date AND coalesce(org00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) ORDER BY org00_org_cd, org00_seq

SELECT FROM org00_org_info o WHERE org00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND org00_company_id = #{companyId} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(x.org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info x WHERE x.org00_org_code_id = o.org00_org_code_id AND x.org00_mod_date <= #{baseDate} )

SELECT org00_org_id AS org_code_id , org00_org_cd AS org_cd , org00_kor_nm AS kor_nm , org00_kor_nm ||COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE '('||STRING_AGG(org_nm,', ')||')' END FROM ( SELECT * FROM getSubOrg(org00_org_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) WHERE org_id != org00_org_id AND tdm_yn != 'true' ) t ),'') AS kor_nm_with_sub_org FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) WHERE 1=1 AND CONCAT(org00_org_cd, org00_kor_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} AND org00_tdm_yn = 'true'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm23_role_relate_org WHERE tdm23_org_id = org00_org_id AND tdm23_role_id = #{roleId} )
ORDER BY org00_org_cd

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org00_org_info a WHERE a.org00_ignore_stamp = 'true' AND a.org00_org_code_id = ( SELECT emp03_org_code_id FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = #{personId} AND emp03_trans_cd != '800' ORDER BY emp03_trans_date DESC LIMIT 1 )
